skill_name: Write a report on the benefits of living a healthier lifestyle.
workflow:
We all know that leading a healthy lifestyle has numerous benefits but sometimes we may not be fully aware of the impact that it has on our lives. There are those who are mindful and make the necessary changes while others ignore the implications of not living a healthy lifestyle.
